name: Philips Home Appliances
legalEntityNote: Philips-branded domestic appliances are operated by Versuni under licence from Koninklijke Philips N.V. Versuni is not a Royal Philips subsidiary, and Royal Philips continues to operate other Philips consumer-health categories outside Versuni.

ownership.summary: Hillhouse acquired the former Philips Domestic Appliances business from Royal Philips in 2021. The independent company adopted the Versuni name in 2023 and continues to develop, market and support Philips-branded domestic appliances under a trademark licence from Koninklijke Philips N.V. Royal Philips retained the Philips trademark and does not directly own Versuni.
ownership.parentCompany: Privately held Versuni, acquired by Hillhouse from Royal Philips

leadership.name: Haoyu Shen
leadership.context: Versuni announced Haoyu Shen as interim CEO effective 27 October 2025 after Veronique Pauwels stepped down.

productPortfolio.name: Vacuum cleaners and AquaTrio systems
productPortfolio.positioning: Philips cordless, wet-and-dry and market-specific vacuum ranges address dry cleaning and hard-floor washing.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Model architecture, included tools, filter supply, detergent rules and service terms need market-level verification.

productPortfolio.name: OneUp electric mop
productPortfolio.positioning: A compact electric-mop platform introduced for routine hard-floor cleaning with separated clean and dirty water.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Creates a lighter step below full wet-and-dry vacuums, but pads, cleaning solution and launch-market availability matter.

productPortfolio.name: Kitchen and coffee appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Airfryers, blenders, kettles, coffee systems and related appliances form a large part of Versuni's Philips portfolio.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: These categories may use different factories, certifications and channel partners from floor-care products.

productPortfolio.name: Garment care and air treatment
productPortfolio.positioning: Irons, steamers, air purifiers and climate products extend the licensed Philips domestic-appliance range.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Buyers should confirm which Versuni or regional entity supplies, imports and warrants the exact category.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Versuni identifies itself as the company responsible for Philips-branded domestic appliances and operates a mix of owned manufacturing and external suppliers.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not infer a universal Philips factory; verify the legal manufacturer and production site for the exact SKU.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Current product documentation can name Versuni Holding B.V. or another Versuni company as the responsible manufacturer while the Philips mark is used under licence.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the model number, responsible company, declaration, rating label and origin statement.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Regional Versuni companies and distributors can have separate selling, importing, data and warranty roles.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Identify the invoice seller, importer, app or data operator and warranty provider for the destination market.

marketsChannels.evidence: Versuni says its brand portfolio reaches consumers in more than 100 countries.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm current category availability and after-sales capability in the target country.

marketsChannels.evidence: Philips domestic appliances are sold through official country sites, retailers, marketplaces and distribution partners.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify seller authorization, local warranty and grey-market restrictions before committing inventory.

marketsChannels.evidence: The Philips brand also appears on Royal Philips products outside Versuni's domestic-appliance scope.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm that the proposed product and agreement fall within Versuni's licensed appliance categories.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Philips Home Appliances benefits from a globally recognized trademark and Versuni's dedicated appliance organization, broad international reach and strong kitchen and garment-care categories. Floor care offers cross-category retailer access but competes against specialist platforms with faster product cycles. The main diligence risk is assuming that the Philips logo identifies Royal Philips as the product company, factory or warranty provider.
